title: Anonymous international product company (Conversion Fanatics donation study): charity banner (win)
company: Anonymous international product company (Conversion Fanatics donation study)

notes: Premium signups +21.9%, revenue per visitor +24.5%. Same three-arm experiment as top-banner comparison. Over 45,000 unique visitors and about 4,300 transactions; not exact counts. Subscription classification inferred from signup/premium tiers.
